{{Quote|There are depths.|Osamael Or|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
'''''The Gree, and Everything I Have Found of Them in the Old City''''' was a personal [[Book/Legends|diary]] written in a [[Unidentified symbology|symbology]] by the [[Tythan]] [[Scout/Legends|frontiersman]] [[Osamael Or]] during his exploration of the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

{{Stub}}

==Overview==
{{Quote|Much of what it says is obscure and does lead me to believe the stories of Osamael's madness. But there are three mentions of something that translates as 'step to the stars.' And toward the end of the diary&mdash;it's very short, and I suspect much more once existed&mdash;he says he's searching for designs.|Lanoree Brock|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
''The Gree, and Everything I Have Found of Them in the Old City'' was written in a [[Unidentified symbology|symbology]]. Within the text, Osamael Or described a [[Gree device|device]] that was powered by [[Dark matter/Legends|dark matter]], which was translated as a [[Hypergate|'step to the stars']].<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Description==
''The Gree, and Everything I Have Found of Them in the Old City'' was a [[Leather/Legends|leather]]-bound book, handwritten in ink on [[Paper/Legends|paper]] and card. The cover was worn around the edges and blank.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==History==
{{Quote|It seems he found something of the Gree down there. And if my translation of the diary's obtuse wording is accurate, the technology your spies heard about&mdash;the dark matter device&mdash;might well be of Gree origin.|Lanoree Brock|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
Osamael Or's diary would later fall into the possession of the [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]] industrialist [[Kara (Je'daii)|Kara]], who kept the leather-bound book in a [[Gazz Spire|secret collection]] of ancient artifacts. In [[25,793 BBY]], [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] would find the script "strange," the wording of the book "obtuse," and much of what it describes obscure.<ref name="Into the Void" />
